title: Shrinkage Analysis Request Tool
short_desc: An internal app used by 35–50 colleagues every week to request and follow shrinkage analyses of moulded parts. I maintained and improved it.
blueprint_desc: Users submit requests in a simple app, while administrators manage them from a dashboard. Behind the scenes, automated flows handle approvals, status updates, record-keeping and email notifications — so requests move along without anyone having to chase them.
tech_notes: Managed the optimization of a production-grade Power Apps ecosystem split clean across user request portals and admin management dashboards. Built and maintained backend Power Automate flows to handle complex approvals, status routing, data logging, and automated notification emails to streamline weekly analysis request pipelines.
